basic_details.job_title: MoFPI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India, is engaging 4 Young Professionals on contract basis for 2 years in the National Programme Monitoring Unit (NPMU) of the "Pradhan Mantri Formalization of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme" (PMFME), at ₹60,000 per month for each post. The posts are Young Professional (Technical) – 2, Young Professional (Management) – 1 and Young Professional (Media & PR) – 1, with an upper age limit of 32 years and a minimum of 2 years' experience. Typed applications in the prescribed format must be emailed to [email protected] betwe

how_to_apply: Use the application proforma at Annexure-II of the notice (Ministry of Food Processing Industries Application Form), with the post and Advertisement No. M-11/6/2020-(FME)(Part-I).
Type the application: handwritten forms will not be accepted.

Give personal details, educational qualifications from Bachelor's Degree onwards, professional experience in chronological order, courses/training, languages known and additional information in support of suitability, as the form asks; attach extra sheets if required.
Affix a recent passport-size colour photograph and sign the declaration.
Attach the self-attested documents listed below and an updated CV/Resume.
Email the application to [email protected] so that it is received by 27 November 2026 (5:30 PM).
Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
Self-attested certificates of relevant courses/training, if applicable
Any other relevant supporting documents as prescribed in the advertisement

content_sections.heading: MoFPI Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India
Pradhan Mantri Formalization of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME)
2 years on contract basis (extendable based on performance review and functional requirements)
Young Professional (Technical), Young Professional (Management), Young Professional (Media & PR)

content_sections.heading: About MoFPI
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries is a ministry of the Government of India with its office at Panchsheel Bhawan, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi - 110049. The Young Professionals will work in the National Programme Monitoring Unit (NPMU) of the PMFME Scheme. The notice is issued under the signature of S. N. Ahmad, Deputy Director, and dated 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Ministry has advertised 4 Young Professional positions in three streams. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years for all three posts. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. Each post has its own qualification and experience requirement, given below. Desirable: Experience in Product value chain, backward & forward linkages, Quality assurance, Enterprise Promotion. Desirable: MBA/PGDM specialisation in Business Analytics, Agribusiness, Marketing, Rural Management, Operations, Project Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Public Policy. The notice lists this experience for the post: Minimum 02 years in graphic design and visual communication. Print, digital, & outdoor campaign and event branding experience. Audio-visual skills in video editing and motion graphics. End-to-end management of creative projects from concept to production. Experience of handling national campaigns in Govt set up will be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Post-Graduation in Food Technology / Food Engineering / Food Processing / Post Harvest Engineering / Food Science / Food Safety and Quality Assurance (Full Time)
rows.experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in Food Processing Industries or Food & Agri Business Sector

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Applied Arts, Fine Arts, Multimedia Design, Animation or a related discipline from a recognised University/Institute
rows.experience: Minimum 02 years in graphic design and visual communication (further experience listed below)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each Young Professional gets ₹60,000 per month. The remuneration shall be consolidated and inclusive of applicable taxes, payable monthly subject to satisfactory services and attendance certification. Income tax and other applicable taxes shall be deducted at source as per prevailing rules; the Consultant/YP is responsible for individual tax liabilities. Extension of the contract and revision in remuneration shall be subject to the prescribed norms in the contract. Official travel needs prior approval of the competent authority. Travel, accommodation and other admissible expenses shall be reimbursed as per the applicable terms and conditions. No other allowances or facilities shall be admissible unless specifically provided. The engagement is purely contractual for two years from the date of engagement. Extension shall be considered based on satisfactory performance and the recommendations of the Performance Review Committee. Leave entitlement is as prescribed under the contractual terms. Unavailed leave shall not be carried forward or encashed.

content_sections.heading: MoFPI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Support the NPMU in day-to-day project management and operational activities, including data collection, synthesis and analysis, preparation of reports, presentations, executive summaries and briefing materials. Provide technical and analytical inputs in areas such as Food Technology, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Data Analysis and Project Management. Assist in inter-institutional coordination, knowledge management and monitoring of project progress to ensure timely completion of activities. Undertake review and assessment of proposals relating to the establishment and operationalisation of Incubation Centres, Common facilities in food processing, etc. Undertake special tasks related to project implementation, as and when assigned by MoFPI. Perform any other work assigned by the competent authority. Analyse existing scheme data, generate insights and evaluate trends and projections to support evidence-based implementation of the Scheme and recommend corrective measures, wherever necessary. Conceptualise performance-monitoring parameters for scheme stakeholders and develop standardised reporting formats to track physical and financial progress under the Scheme. Undertake scrutiny, evaluation and assessment of Branding and Marketing proposals under the scheme. Establish tie-ups and linkages with e-commerce platforms to facilitate the onboarding and promotion of PMFME-supported food products. Undertake special tasks related to project implementation, as and when assigned by MoFPI. Perform any other work assigned by the competent authority. The Graphic Designer & Audio-Visual Creative Specialist shall be responsible for conceptualising, designing and producing high-quality visual communication materials for the PMFME Scheme across print, outdoor, digital and audio-visual media. The incumbent will support the Ministry in developing impactful branding assets for ministerial events, exhibitions, publicity initiatives and stakeholder outreach, while ensuring consistency with Government communication standards and the PMFME brand identity.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Ministry reserves the right to shortlist and restrict the number of candidates called for interaction to a reasonable limit, based on their qualifications, relevant experience and academic achievements exceeding the minimum eligibility criteria. Eligibility and suitability shall be assessed on the information in the applications and the supporting documents submitted. No correspondence shall be entertained from candidates who are not shortlisted or called for interaction. The date of the interaction is not specified in the notice.

rows.details: Prescribed proforma to be typed and emailed

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MoFPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 Young Professional vacancies: 2 for Technical, 1 for Management and 1 for Media & PR, in the NPMU of the PMFME Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MoFPI Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed by 27 November 2026 (5:30 PM); applications received after the closing date and time will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MoFPI Young Professional (Technical)?
faq.answer: A full-time Post-Graduation in Food Technology / Food Engineering / Food Processing / Post Harvest Engineering / Food Science / Food Safety and Quality Assurance, with minimum 2 years' experience in Food Processing Industries or Food & Agri Business Sector.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Management and Media & PR posts?
faq.answer: Young Professional (Management) needs an MBA/PGDM (Full Time) with minimum 2 years of relevant experience. Young Professional (Media & PR) needs a Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Applied Arts, Fine Arts, Multimedia Design, Animation or a related discipline, with minimum 02 years in graphic design and visual communication.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MoFPI Young Professional?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a MoFPI Young Professional?
faq.answer: Each post carries ₹60,000 per month, consolidated and inclusive of applicable taxes, with tax deducted at source.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MoFPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Type the Annexure-II application form, attach self-attested documents and an updated CV/Resume, and email it to [email protected]; handwritten forms will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How will MoFPI select Young Professionals?
faq.answer: The Ministry may shortlist candidates based on qualifications, relevant experience and academic achievements exceeding the minimum criteria and call them for interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MoFPI Young Professional job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual for two years from the date of engagement, and the Young Professional shall not be considered a regular employee or official of MoFPI. Extension depends on satisfactory performance and the Performance Review Committee's recommendations.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances paid on top of the ₹60,000 remuneration?
faq.answer: No other allowances or facilities are admissible unless specifically provided; only approved official travel, accommodation and other admissible expenses are reimbursed as per the applicable terms.
